name: Greece: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Greece package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: CTIS Part II Trial Sites structured data complete for every Greek site (each a public hospital or private clinic with suitable infrastructure).
K1 on the EU template v2.0, with a section for every population pathway in the plan.
K2 final Greek recruitment material for every recruitment tool used.

One L1 Greek information and consent set per population in population_sets whose trigger is true, including the separate optional-use, pregnancy, infant and emergency-representative forms where they apply.
L2 other Greek participant or caregiver information given before or at consent.
Valid or certified translations for planned participants who do not understand Greek.
Endpoint questionnaires and PRO instruments in Part I with the protocol, not duplicated in Part II.
For every Greek site: M1 CV, M2 declaration of interest, N1 site-suitability form signed by the principal investigator.
Phase I: principal-investigator Article 7 declaration and ALS certificates under M; declaration and equipment and emergency-capability evidence under N.
O1 insurer-executed certificate identifying the trial and coverage, with the pregnancy clause.
P1 EU compensation form.
P2 unsigned Government Gazette B 230/2026 annexes per site; no signed financial agreement.
R1 GDPR compliance statement, including any third-country transfer.
S1 biological-samples form in English.
Every participant- or caregiver-facing document is in Greek.
Administrative documents in English (recommended) or Greek; an official Greek translation available if EOF requests one.

No signatures in uploaded K, L, M1/M2, P and S documents unless a template instruction or the National Ethics Committee requires one; N1 and the Phase I declaration signed by the principal investigator; O1 executed by the insurer.
Blank Greek consent forms carry every applicable future signature and full-date field (participant, both parents, representative, investigator or authorised team member, witnesses).
Same trial title, protocol code, site, department and principal-investigator details throughout CTIS and every document.
Compensation amounts and conditions identical in P1 and every participant document.
Insurance and injury-compensation wording, including the pregnancy clause, identical in O1 and every participant document.
Sample types, storage, transfers and retention identical in S1, the protocol and the participant documents.
Data flows, recipients, transfers and retention identical in R1, the participant documents and the protocol.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain all Greek national additions and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Greece is not the reference package

items.check: Correct section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document.

Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, only the fields that distinguish the document, country code EL (DECISIONS.md D1).
Version and date in CTIS metadata, not in the title; every participant-facing page shows document type, protocol code or acronym, version and date, with continuous pagination and total pages.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean and tracked-change Greek consent forms uploaded for a modification; redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
No obsolete national forms used under the former Clinical Trials Directive unless current CTR guidance expressly retains the content or annex.
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Greece receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: Personal data and confidential information removed from every document version intended for publication under the current CTIS transparency rules.
Public and assessment versions differ only by the intended redactions; each in the correct CTIS slot.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
